intent: The dashboard starts a "claude -p" process to name a session (its folder is under the temp folder, named openagent-naming- and some letters). On 2026-11-21 one was still alive 12 minutes after it started, as a child of the dashboard. Find why the naming process is not ended once the name is given (or after a timeout), make sure it always ends, and add a test that fails without the fix. Open a pull request with a short title and body.
title: Naming process not terminating
